nodes.statement: A surjective additive homomorphism between finite additive groups sends the uniform distribution to the uniform distribution: Pr[f x = y] = 1/card H.
nodes.proof_route: Mathlib AddMonoidHom.card_fiber_eq_of_mem_range identifies all fiber cardinalities. Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise counts the domain as |H| times one nonempty fiber. Divide the canonical cardinal ratio.

nodes.statement: For finite field F and distinct z,z' : Fin d → F, Pr_a[linearForm a z = linearForm a z'] = 1/card F.
nodes.proof_route: Subtract z' from z. A nonzero difference coordinate j gives surjectivity of a ↦ sum_i a_i*(z_i-z'_i), witnessed by a single nonzero coordinate a_j = t/(z_j-z'_j). Apply the generic additive-hom fiber theorem at 0.

nodes.statement: Two independent uniform coefficient vectors collide on distinct z,z' with probability exactly 1/(card F)^2.
nodes.proof_route: Finite function-coordinate product factorization on Fin 2 and the exact single-form collision formula.

      linearForm (a 0) z = linearForm (a 0) z' ∧

nodes.statement: For exact canonical Forms F d k, arbitrary events E_p on the two coefficient vectors at each layer/level pair p in A satisfy Pr[all E_p] = product_{p in A} Pr[E_p].
nodes.proof_route: Explicit bijective re-indexing formsPairEquiv: (Fin 2 → Fin k → F → Fin d → F) ≃ ((Fin k × F) → Fin 2 → Fin d → F), followed by uniformProb_equiv and finite-coordinate product factorization.

    {d k : ℕ} (A : Finset (Fin k × F))
    (E : (Fin k × F) → (Fin 2 → Fin d → F) → Prop) :
    uniformProb (fun s : Forms F d k =>
      ∀ p ∈ A, E p (fun j => s j p.1 p.2)) =
      ∏ p ∈ A, uniformProb (E p)

nodes.statement: For exact canonical Forms, if z_p ≠ z_p′ for every p in A, the event that both forms at every p collide on z_p,z_p′ has probability exactly (1/(card F)^2)^(card A).
nodes.proof_route: Apply uniformProb_forms_events to collision predicates at each pair, then exact two-form probability and product of a constant.

theorem uniformProb_forms_collisions {F : Type*} [Field F] [Fintype F]
    {d k : ℕ} (A : Finset (Fin k × F)) (z z' : (Fin k × F) → Fin d → F)
    (hne : ∀ p ∈ A, z p ≠ z' p) :
    uniformProb (fun s : Forms F d k => ∀ p ∈ A,
      linearForm (s 0 p.1 p.2) (z p) = linearForm (s 0 p.1 p.2) (z' p) ∧
      linearForm (s 1 p.1 p.2) (z p) = linearForm (s 1 p.1 p.2) (z' p)) =
      (1 / (Fintype.card F : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ A.card
